note: The provider/models the examples record with. `model` is the text model, `vision_model` the one used for image input (Lesson 5.4), `embed_model` the embedding model (Module 6). Changing these changes every cassette key they appear in; re-record after editing. Override per run with LEARNAI_LLM_PROVIDER / LEARNAI_LLM_MODEL / LEARNAI_LLM_VISION_MODEL / LEARNAI_LLM_EMBED_MODEL.
